_comment: Bob shell (bob) theme — edit and relaunch, or run /theme reload. Deleting a key falls back to the built-in default. `theme` picks a named palette: mauve (default) | dark | light | daltonized (colour-blind safe) | ansi (the terminal's own 16 colours; also the truecolor fallback). To tweak individual swatches, add a `colors` block (accent, success, error, warn, tool, muted) — it overrides the theme. Colours are rich style strings (name, #hex, or e.g. 'bold #ffcc00'). Setting NO_COLOR (non-empty) in the environment forces monochrome regardless of theme.
